summary: Grayback Mountain, Klickitat County WA: L-4 cab built 1945, two-story DNR cab 1972 removed 1996; access now restricted by gates per one undated report.

facts.design: L-4 cab (1945); later a two-story DNR cab (1972)
facts.status_note: The two-story DNR cab was removed in 1996. The sources read do not describe what, if anything, remains on the summit now.

access.note: WillhiteWeb reports that a landowner behind a gate said all access is restricted and new signs are posted. The page gives no date for this.

visit.trail_note: WillhiteWeb gives 5.5 miles from the lower gate and 4.3 miles from the upper gate, with 1,600 feet of elevation gain.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: WillhiteWeb reports a correspondent who said there was no lookout on top in 1973, a 1979 DNR survey that made no mention of one, and a 1989 National Geodetic Survey crew that did mention one. The story reports the disagreement and does not pick a date.

sources.title: Grayback Mountain, Forest Lookouts (quoting local newspapers, 1950-1960)

notes_for_editor: Read the four source pages, two of them with extra greps, so about 6 reads counting repeats, and ran 1 web search. The brief's kind 'two_story' describes the last structure only; the 1945 L-4 cab's end is not dated in any source, so it was not changed. Current-site status rests on WillhiteWeb's undated access note; nothing read describes the summit today. Summit and site elevations differ (WillhiteWeb gives a 3,799 ft summit) and are not used in the story. A Pacific Northwest activation report from 2021 mentions DNR ownership of the summit, but it was only a search snippet and is not cited.
